newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain 91-day treasury bills yield unchanged 5.74.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain 91-day treasury bills yield unchanged 5.74.

text.p: The average yield at this week's tender for 10 million dinars of 91-day Bahrain treasury bills was unchanged at last week's 5.74 percent, a spokesman for the Bahrain Monetary Agency said on Monday.
The average price was also steady at 98.570. The minimum price accepted edged down to 98.565 from 98.567.
Banks submitted bids for 23 million dinars worth of bills, down from 31.2 million dinars last week.
Maturing on September 24, the bills were offered on Monday and will be issued on Wednesday.
